question.text: For how many days must the draft offer document be made available to the public for comments after filing with SEBI?

explanation.text: The Logic: The draft offer document filed with SEBI must be made public for comments for at least 21 days from the date of filing. It is hosted on the SEBI, stock exchange, and lead manager websites during this period. The Trap: 30 days is the SEBI observation period, not the public comment period — these are two distinct timelines that candidates often confuse. Note: Comments received during the public period and any consequential changes are filed with SEBI after the 21-day period.
